editorial:
Imagine you are hired for a simple nursing job, but instead of giving medicine, your main task is to scare away a bunch of annoying relatives. That is exactly what happens to Nurse Vera in this zany comedy. She teams up with her patient to create total chaos in the house, using tricks and pranks to make the unwelcome guests want to leave as fast as possible. It feels like a wild party where everything that can go wrong does, and the energy never really lets up. If you like old-school humor where people run around and get into clumsy accidents, you will love the vibe here.

What really makes this work is the physical comedy. The actors know how to sell a joke without saying a word, and the pacing keeps you smiling throughout. While some of the gags might feel a bit dated, the heart of the story is just plain fun. You should definitely check this out if you need a lighthearted break from heavy dramas. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV to see all the funny expressions clearly. If you are a fan of physical comedy, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head in a giant, messy climax where the pranks finally push the relatives to their limit. After a series of loud arguments and funny mishaps, the unwelcome family members realize they are not wanted and finally pack their bags. The patient gets his peace and quiet back, and Nurse Vera is celebrated for her unconventional methods. It wraps up with everyone happy and the house finally becoming a calm place again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school slapstick humor and funny misunderstandings.
